newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun Dev ponders new China venture.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun Dev ponders new China venture.

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd said on Monday it was in talks with an arm of China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co and its subsidiaries, COSCO Group, about forming a 50 percent joint venture China infrastructure arm.

In a joint statement by Lai Sun Garment International Ltd , Lai Sun Development and Lai Sun Hotels International Ltd published on Tuesday, the companies said the new company would tentatively be named COSCO Lai Sun Infrastructure (China) Ltd, and would undertake China projects.
"The scope of activities of the joint venture is expected to include projects such as toll roads, bridges and power plants," they said.
The statement said Lai Sun Hotels was also exploring with a private company within the COSCO Group opportunities for managing COSCO Group hotels in Hong Kong.
However, discussions for both prospective "cooperative opportunities" were at a preliminary stage, they said.
The statement follows the March acquisition by a COSCO Group company, COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd, of 20 percent of Lai Sun Hotels, becoming its second largest shareholder in the process.
Tuesday's statement also follows the April announcement that Lai Sun Development planned to buy 45.87 million shares, or 2.25 percent, of COSCO Pacific Ltd for HK$477.05 million.
COSCO Pacific is a container leasing and terminal operator, ultimately controlled by China Ocean Shipping (Group).

The three companies said they issued Tuesday's statement because a circular sent to Lai Sun Garment shareholders on Lai Sun Development plans to invest in COSCO Pacific had information not previously furnished to Lai Sun Garment, Lai Sun Development and Lai Sun Hotels shareholders.
